questions.question: Language skills are commonly grouped under how many abilities?
questions.explanation: Language skills are commonly grouped into listening, speaking, reading, and writing.

questions.question: The LANGUAGE SKILLS topic primarily covers which pair?
questions.explanation: The provided slides focus mainly on reading skill and writing skill.

questions.question: Which ability appears in the learning objectives for LANGUAGE SKILLS?
questions.explanation: The first learning objective is to define the term language skills.

questions.question: The learning objectives require differentiating listening and speaking and also which other pair?
questions.explanation: The objectives include differentiating reading and writing.

questions.question: Ogayi and Chima 2005 define reading skill as the ability to do which?
questions.explanation: Reading skill involves perceiving and understanding writing symbols.

questions.question: In reading, the reader uses which resource to interpret meaning?
questions.explanation: Readers use previous knowledge of words and context to interpret meaning.

questions.question: In the reading process, the writer is described as which?
questions.explanation: The writer encodes the message while the reader decodes it.

questions.question: In reading, the reader is referred to as which?
questions.explanation: The reader decodes the message tied up by the writer.

questions.question: The writer uses which signs and symbols to convey messages?
questions.explanation: The writer writes using graphological signs and symbols.

questions.question: Reading requires recognizing letters and reading groups of letters as which?
questions.explanation: A basic reading ability is recognizing groups of letters as words.

questions.question: Reading ability includes understanding relationships between clauses and which other unit?
questions.explanation: Reading involves understanding relationships between clauses and sentences.

questions.question: Understanding the grammar of a sentence is listed as which reading ability?
questions.explanation: Understanding sentence grammar is listed as a reading ability.

questions.question: Reading skill involves perceiving and understanding which elements?
questions.explanation: Reading deals with seeing and recognizing written symbols.

questions.question: Which purpose of reading involves gaining knowledge from texts?
questions.explanation: Reading is done to get information.

questions.question: Reading for enjoyment is captured by which purpose?
questions.explanation: One purpose of reading is to be entertained.

questions.question: Which purpose of reading supports professional practice?
questions.explanation: Reading supports training and practice in one's profession.

questions.question: Which purpose of reading helps solve difficulties?
questions.explanation: Reading can be used to solve problems.

questions.question: Which purpose of reading develops intellectual ability?
questions.explanation: Reading helps develop intellectual ability.

questions.question: Reading for rest and calmness serves which purpose?
questions.explanation: Relaxation is listed as a purpose of reading.

questions.question: Reading without audible noise is called which type?
questions.explanation: Silent reading is reading without audible noise.

questions.question: Reading with audible noise is known as which type?
questions.explanation: Reading aloud involves audible noise.

questions.question: Which reading type is especially used during speech presentation?
questions.explanation: Reading aloud is particularly useful during speech presentation.

questions.question: Reading to solve a particular problem is called which type?
questions.explanation: Creative reading targets a particular problem.

questions.question: Critical reading involves reacting to which aspect of a text?
questions.explanation: Critical reading reacts to what is good or bad in a text.

questions.question: Intensive reading is also known by which name?
questions.explanation: Intensive reading is also known as slow-careful reading.

questions.question: Intensive reading is used for which kind of text?
questions.explanation: Intensive reading is used for a small amount of difficult text.

questions.question: In intensive reading, the reader often focuses on which element?
questions.explanation: Intensive reading often focuses on language rather than the text.

questions.question: Vocalisation in reading refers to which habit?
questions.explanation: Vocalisation means pronouncing each word aloud as one reads.

questions.question: Sub-vocalisation involves hearing words where?
questions.explanation: Sub-vocalisation means pronouncing words within the mind.

questions.question: Counting words while reading mainly causes which problem?
questions.explanation: Counting words slows the speed of reading.

questions.question: Finger pointing is described as a reading practice common among which group?
questions.explanation: Finger pointing is used by children and not adults.

questions.question: Head movement during reading is criticized because it reduces which quality?
questions.explanation: Moving the head side to side reduces concentration.

questions.question: Daydreaming during reading involves thinking about which kind of ideas?
questions.explanation: Daydreaming involves thinking of irrelevant things not related to reading.

questions.question: Which practice helps break the habit of daydreaming during reading?
questions.explanation: Having a purpose and making notes improve concentration.

questions.question: Memorisation in reading is described as which kind of activity?
questions.explanation: Memorisation is described as a psychological and mental activity.

questions.question: Memorisation is considered a bad reading form because of which risk?
questions.explanation: Memorisation risks inability to recall under psychological tension.

questions.question: Ogayi 2005 defines writing skill as the skillful use of which elements?
questions.explanation: Writing skill uses language symbols to express thoughts and ideas.

questions.question: Writing skill involves expressing ideas through which medium?
questions.explanation: Writing expresses ideas through written words.

questions.question: Writing development begins with recognizing letters and then moves to which step?
questions.explanation: Writing starts from letters to spelling of words.

questions.question: Ogayi 2005 says a writer needs to organize ideas in which unit?
questions.explanation: The writer needs to organize pieces of information or ideas in paragraphs.

questions.question: Extensive and regular reading improves writing by providing which benefit?
questions.explanation: Reading exposes writers to new vocabulary and good presentations.

questions.question: Writing with the audience in mind helps determine which choice?
questions.explanation: Audience determines whether writing is formal or informal.

questions.question: Using informal words in an official document is described as which?
questions.explanation: Informal words are wrong in documents meant for official matters.

questions.question: A writer should handle tone in which manner?
questions.explanation: Writers should set an appropriate tone when writing.

questions.question: Reading your writing aloud helps mainly to detect which issues?
questions.explanation: Reading aloud helps draw attention to areas where there are errors.

questions.question: Reading writing aloud helps remove wrong grammar and which other feature?
questions.explanation: Reading aloud helps remove wrong grammar and punctuation marks.

questions.question: Using only one sentence type in writing is described as which?
questions.explanation: Using only one sentence type sounds monotonous.

questions.question: Combining different sentence types helps writing maintain which quality?
questions.explanation: Different sentence types maintain good rhythm and natural flow.

questions.question: Unity in writing requires every element to support which item?
questions.explanation: Unity requires all elements to support one central idea.

questions.question: Cohesion in writing requires every idea to be linked to which element?
questions.explanation: Cohesion links every idea to the central idea in the work.
